items.excerpt: Chinese robotics company Agibot brought its full-size A3 and half-size X2 humanoid robots to a London launch event on June 30, showing off backflipping, football-playing 'humanoids' up close and pitching robots that 'understand you, talk to you, and work for you.'

A hobbyist is giving his self-hosted home AI a physical 'body' one sensor at a time, wiring cameras, microphones and environmental sensors into a DIY embodied assistant that lives in the house rather than the cloud.

Google's latest Home app update makes automations easier to build, speeds up camera setup and live view, and continues the Gemini for Home rollout — including new visual cards on Nest Hub for early access members.

Apple's new AI security-camera features in the Home app — Apple Intelligence video descriptions and searchable 4K HomeKit Secure Video clips — will require a 2TB iCloud+ subscription, and 9to5Mac argues gating camera AI behind a storage tier is the wrong call.

SwitchBot launched the $79.99 Outdoor Pan/Tilt Cam 3K in North America and the UK — a security camera that tracks moving subjects and uses AI to summarize what happened in a clip, like a delivery arriving or someone approaching the house.
XDA reviews AMD's tiny Ryzen AI Halo box and finds it does what Nvidia's DGX Spark does at a fraction of the power — a compact local-AI machine for running LLMs at home without the cloud.

Apple seeded the third developer beta of visionOS 27, the Vision Pro update that brings eye-tracked Siri AI activation, an anywhere-placeable Siri orb with visual awareness of what you're looking at, curved windows and panorama-to-spatial environments.

GMKtec's NucBox K17 mini PC pairs Intel's Core Ultra 5 226V — with integrated NPU for on-device AI acceleration and Arc 130V graphics — with whisper-quiet fans, continuing the wave of small NPU-equipped desktop machines.

Hands-on with the Nothing Phone (4b), the first of Nothing's new (b) series: a budget phone with a dedicated Essential Key that triggers Essential Voice, Essential Search and the company's AI-powered apps at an 'impossible' price.

Nothing announced the Phone (4b) with a 120Hz AMOLED display, Snapdragon 6 Gen 4, a Glyph Bar and an Essential Key for AI features including the upgraded AI voice-to-text 'Essential Voice.' (Same launch as the 9to5Google hands-on — alternate outlet.)
